text.PromptLens · 不懂 Prompt 也能写出高质量提示词: PromptLens · Write good prompts without prompt engineering
text.你不是不会写 Prompt，: You're not bad at writing prompts;
text.免注册试用不保存记录，离开页面即清空。: Guest use saves no records — everything is cleared when you leave the page.
text.整个过程只有四步，中间不需要你写任何一个字的技术细节 —— 你只需要做选择。: Four steps, and you never write a word of technical detail along the way — all you do is make choices.
text.把一句模糊的需求，拆成角色、受众、格式、语气、约束这些具体问题。 你说「帮我写个: A vague request becomes concrete questions: role, audience, format, tone, constraints. Say “write me a weekly report” and it asks who it is for, how long it should be, and whether to include data.
text.每个问题都给几种方案，点按钮就行。看不懂的术语旁边有大白话解释， 还有正反示例告: Every question offers a few options — just click. Terms you do not know come with a plain-language note, plus good and bad examples showing what your prompt turns into once you choose.
text.你的每个选择都会引出更细的追问。选了「视频」就会接着问镜头、运镜、时长、光线，: Every choice pulls in a sharper follow-up. Pick “video” and it goes on to ask about shots, camera movement, duration and lighting, until what you need is fully spelled out.
text.生成一份可以直接复制的成品 Prompt，并附上「你做过哪些决定」的完整清单，: Out comes a finished prompt you can copy straight away, plus a full list of the decisions you made and a line-by-line note on why it is written this way.
text.和「让 AI 直接帮你写」有什么不同: How is this different from letting AI write it for you?
text.让大模型一手包办，你拿到的是它猜的；拆开做选择，你拿到的是你要的。 这就是为什么: Hand the whole job to a model and you get its guess. Break it into choices and you get what you asked for. That is why a PromptLens result does not read like AI wrote it.
text.它替你猜受众、猜语气、猜长度: It guesses the audience, the tone and the length for you
text.结果好坏靠运气，同一句话每次都不一样: How good it turns out is luck — the same sentence comes out different every time
text.不满意只能重说一遍，说不清哪里不对: If you are unhappy you just restate it, unable to say what went wrong
text.拿到的 Prompt 里全是「请以专业的口吻」这类空话: The prompt you get is full of filler like “write in a professional tone”
text.每个决定都由你来做，系统只负责问对问题: You make every decision; the system only asks the right questions
text.同样的选择一定得到同样的结构，可复现: The same choices always produce the same structure — it is reproducible
text.不满意可以「改上一处」，只动那一个变量: Not happy? Use “Change the last choice” and only that one variable moves
text.成品里写的是具体约束：字数、格式、必须包含什么: The finished prompt states concrete constraints: word count, format, what must be included
text.三类场景的拆解方式完全不同，所以 PromptLens 走的是三套流程，不是换个: The three scenarios break down in completely different ways, so PromptLens runs three separate flows — not one template with the words swapped out.
text.文案、周报、邮件、脚本、方案。拆到角色、受众、篇幅、语气、结构、必须包含与必须避: Copywriting, weekly reports, emails, scripts, proposals. Broken down into role, audience, length, tone, structure, what must be included and what must be avoided, and output as Markdown organized by section.
text.可直接用于 ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek、豆包、Kimi 等对: Works directly in ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Doubao, Kimi and other chat models
text.拆到主体、风格、构图、光线、镜头、画幅、画质，负面提示词单独成段， 不和正面描述: Broken down into subject, style, composition, lighting, shot, aspect ratio and image quality — the negative prompt gets its own paragraph, not mixed in with the positive description.
text.可直接用于 Midjourney、Stable Diffusion、Flux、即: Works directly in Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux, Jimeng and other image tools
text.多镜头时会生成一张分镜表：每个镜头的内容、景别、运镜、时长都排好， 而且顺序、秒: With multiple shots it lays out a storyboard: the content, shot size, camera movement and duration of every shot, and you can change the order, the seconds and each cell by hand — or add and remove shots.
text.可直接用于可灵、Runway、即梦等视频工具: Works directly in Kling, Runway, Jimeng and other video tools
text.我完全不懂 Prompt，能用吗？: I know nothing about prompts. Can I still use it?
text.能。你不需要知道什么是「系统提示词」「few-shot」，也不需要背任何句式。: Yes. You do not need to know what a “system prompt” or “few-shot” is, and there is no phrasing to memorize. You just answer everyday questions like “who is this for” and “long or short”, and the system translates the rest into prompt language.
text.它和直接用 ChatGPT 有什么区别？: How is it different from just using ChatGPT?
text.ChatGPT 帮你写，PromptLens 陪你决定。前者你拿到的是一段它猜出: ChatGPT writes it for you; PromptLens makes the decisions with you. The first gives you a stretch of text it guessed at; the second gives you the result of a run of choices you made yourself — and you can look back at every step and change it.
text.生成的 Prompt 能用在哪些工具里？: Which tools can I use the prompt in?
text.文字类的可以直接贴进任何对话模型；图片类的可以贴进 Midjourney、Sta: Text prompts paste straight into any chat model. Image prompts paste into Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Flux or Jimeng — the negative prompt has its own paragraph, so put it in the matching field. Video prompts paste into Kling, Runway or Jimeng.
text.视频的分镜表能自己改吗？: Can I edit the video storyboard myself?
text.能。分镜表是「生成前最后一道人工关」：镜头顺序、每个镜头的秒数、每一格写什么都能: Yes. The storyboard is the last human checkpoint before generation: you can change the shot order, each shot's duration and what goes in each cell, and add or delete shots. Regenerate when you are done and the result follows the version you laid out.
text.为什么同一句话，两个人用会得到不一样的 Prompt？: Why do two people get different prompts from the same sentence?
text.因为中间的选择不一样。同一个需求，给老板看和给同事看，语气、长度、要不要结论先行: Because the choices in between are different. The same request, shown to your boss or to a colleague, calls for a different tone, a different length, and a different call on whether to lead with the conclusion. That is exactly what makes it useful — the result carries your judgement, not a template that fits everyone.
text.要花钱吗？我的需求会被别人看到吗？: Does it cost anything? Will anyone else see what I need?
text.不需要付费。你的拆解记录保存在你自己的账号下，只有登录后才能看到。: No payment needed. Your breakdown history is saved under your own account and is visible only after you log in.
text.下次再遇到「不知道怎么跟 AI 说」，就从这里开始。: Next time you are stuck on “how do I say this to an AI”, start here.
text.第一轮问题大概花你两分钟。: The first round of questions takes about two minutes.
text.把每一个决定权交回用户 —— 这是让结果不像「AI 写的」的关键。: Handing every decision back to the user — that is what keeps the result from reading like AI wrote it.
text.PromptLens 把「写 Prompt」变成一步步做选择：系统拆出角色、受众: PromptLens turns writing a prompt into a series of choices — role, audience, format, tone, constraints. Every decision is yours. It supports text, image and video, and gives you a finished prompt you can copy straight away.
text.拆解维度与产出: What it breaks down and outputs
